exact_missing_items: Each Orchestrator tab needs role-appropriate filters; Orchestrator must support saved views scoped per project; sort defaults: Seams=most operationally problematic first, History=newest first, Ledger=newest first
Settings scope hierarchy must flow: App/Global → Project → Seam → Package → Node → Actor/Role → Runtime only; each scope must support override visibility
Override display rule: all settings pages must show Inherited, Overridden, and Effective values inline without requiring a separate modal

Projection ownership by surface: Project = multi-project status; Dashboard = summary/urgency/entry; Orchestrator = operational depth; Source Control = repo/worktree execution/inspection; chat = HITL resolution
read-only navigation may continue on stale and some degraded projections if the UI says so clearly
live mutating / decision-bearing actions must tighten on trust state
stale: allow inspection and historical navigation; require refresh or direct runtime revalidation before sensitive live actions
degraded: restrict to safe inspection and canonical recovery paths; do not allow ambiguous live actions
unavailable: route to record-backed fallback views or explicit recovery/refresh actions
page state must not silently stand in for runtime state when freshness/trust is insufficient
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
